profile.headline: IT Software Developer at Progressive
profile.summary: I am a recent graduate currently working at Progressive, where I leverage my analytical skills to enhance pricing strategies and customer retention. In my role, I analyze and track rate revisions by considering claims experience, regulatory requirements, and market conditions. I also develop and implement Selenium automation scripts for Progressive Homeowners Insurance, which has significantly improved testing efficiency and accuracy for our web applications. My contributions to the Fast Track revisions process within the Progressive Property team have streamlined policy updates by ensuring that risk assessments and coverage options align with market changes and regulatory standards. I am passionate about using data-driven insights to drive innovation in the industry.

positions.title: Information Technology Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Durham, North Carolina, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Developed and maintained Entity Framework Core data models and DbContext configurations to persist external data sources in a .NET 8 application.

Implemented service classes to parse, map, and store external insurance data sources into the database, ensuring data integrity and efficient processing.

Designed and implemented page object models to streamline and modularize Selenium test automation, improving test maintainability and scalability.
